mainEntity.name: What is the best Read AI alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best Read AI alternative for most teams is the one that matches the follow-up work they do after calls. Want tasks and Jira tickets? Lynkk suits you. Fireflies suits CRM-driven sales teams. Anyone who wants free unlimited recording should start with Fathom.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free alternative to Read AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Fathom offers unlimited free recordings and transcripts. Otter, Jamie and Lynkk have free plans too, capped at 300 minutes, 10 notes and 5 notes a month respectively. For light use, even the smallest of these is comparable, because Read AI's own free plan stops at 5 meetings a month.

mainEntity.name: What is the Microsoft alternative to Read AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Microsoft's alternative is the AI recap in Teams, which comes with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Inside Teams it works well. Zoom, Google Meet and in-person meetings are not covered, though. No Copilot license at your company? Then a third-party tool that joins Teams calls is usually the more affordable route.

mainEntity.name: Who are Read AI's main competitors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read AI's main competitors are Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Fathom, Granola, tl;dv, Jamie and Lynkk, and their approaches differ, from live transcription to bot-free notes to automated follow-up. Compare on free limits, price per user, privacy controls and what happens after the meeting.

mainEntity.name: Can I use a Read AI alternative without a meeting bot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Granola and Jamie are bot-free by design, and Lynkk gives you both options: a bot for Zoom, Meet and Teams, or bot-free recording through its Mac app and Chrome extension. Remember that bot-free capture still records. Announce it at the start of each call, especially with clients.

mainEntity.name: Does any Read AI alternative support Hindi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Lynkk supports Hindi and has a Hinglish setting for conversations that mix Hindi and English. Read AI lists 20+ languages.
